title: Tsuukai!! Slot Shooting
native_title: 痛快！！スロット・シューティング
overview:
Packed with distinctive, fully CG-rendered characters!! A new type of shooting game that gets deeper the more you play.

Tsuukai!! Slot Shooting mixes a shooter with a falling-block puzzle. Cute rendered creatures such as crabs, ladybugs and spiky shells drop from the top of the screen onto the board below. Shoot down the ones you do not want before they land, and let the right ones fall into place. A slot-style window at the top of the screen shows three creatures, and the stages move through settings such as a palm-lined beach, a leafy jungle and a dark night scene.

- One player, or two players
- Multiple levels of rising challenge
- Memory backup saves

個性あるオールCGレンダリングキャラ満載！！
プレイするほど奥が深い新タイプ・シューティングゲームです。
